resources.string:
Your widgets show the numbers the Tracker writes to the "Widget" tab of your Sophmore Year Google Sheet whenever the Tracker is open.

One-time setup:
1. On a computer, open that sheet in Google Sheets (the phone app can't publish).
2. File → Share → Publish to web.
3. Pick the "Widget" tab and "Comma-separated values (.csv)", then Publish.
4. Copy the link it shows, paste it below, and tap Save and test.
5. Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Tracker Widgets, and add the ones you want.

Tap a widget to open the Tracker, or ↻ to refresh it. They also refresh about every 30 minutes.
